clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Venomtail Antidote is urgently needed to save a scout from scorpid poison. Kor'ghan brews the remedy in Orgrimmar for Rhinag, who lies stricken near Durotar's northwestern border.

Durotar's venomtail scorpids can kill a warrior within an hour of a deep sting. Rhinag, a troll scout, was envenomed near the northwestern border, far from aid. His only chance is a remedy from Kor'ghan, an apothecary in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

Finding Kor'ghan means making your way beneath Orgrimmar. He knows desert toxins and harsh remedies, and prepares a vial to purge the venom before it turns fatal. The draught stops the poison and spares Rhinag a humiliating death in the wilderness. Kor'ghan still demands further trials and hunts from the scout to atone for his carelessness.
